sources.expected: The AI Scientist links idea generation, experiment coding and execution, analysis, manuscript writing, and automated review in an end-to-end research pipeline.
Harness^2 uses task-level contrastive Propose–Probe–Compose recursion and a harnessing-level recursion that extracts experience from edits for later tasks.
ARIS combines execution skills and a persistent research wiki with integrity verification, result-to-claim mapping, claim auditing, and reviewer-approved harness improvements.

Production-scale AutoResearch reports infrastructure fragility, agent memory decay, search-direction stagnation, iteration-cost asymmetry, and metric fixation, addressed through prevent, persist, and redirect principles.
FunSearch pairs a pretrained LLM with a systematic evaluator in an evolutionary search over solution-generating programs.
GEPA reflects on execution traces in natural language to propose and test prompt updates and combines complementary candidates from a Pareto frontier.
MLAgentBench evaluates language agents on 13 machine-learning experimentation tasks through actions including file editing, code execution, and output inspection.
AlphaEvolve evolves code through an autonomous LLM pipeline with feedback from one or more evaluators.
EoH evolves natural-language heuristic ideas and their executable code within an evolutionary search framework.
AIDE formulates machine-learning engineering as code optimization and uses tree search to reuse and refine promising solutions.
Agent Laboratory organizes LLM agents across literature review, experimentation, and report writing, while allowing human feedback at each stage.
RE-Bench compares language-model agents and human experts in seven open-ended ML research-engineering environments under varying time budgets.
MLE-bench evaluates agents on 75 Kaggle machine-learning engineering competitions and includes human leaderboard baselines.
SWE-agent studies how agent-computer interface design affects code editing, repository navigation, test execution, and agent performance.
ScienceAgentBench evaluates 102 expert-validated data-driven discovery tasks using program quality, execution results, and cost.
DiscoveryWorld provides 120 simulated tasks requiring hypotheses, experiment design and execution, analysis, and conclusions.
AgentBench evaluates LLM agents across eight interactive environments and analyzes reasoning, decision-making, and instruction-following failures.
CogAlpha represents alphas as code and combines LLM reasoning, evolutionary mutations and recombination, multi-stage prompts, and financial feedback.
AlphaGen uses reinforcement learning to optimize a synergistic collection of formulaic alphas through downstream combination-model performance.

paragraph_task: Draft the English manuscript unit 'Related work' using only the registered evidence and verified literature sources.
editor_instruction: Verify bibliographic metadata and claim scope at the original source before citing any literature lead. The historical survey alone does not authorize a citation. Preserve every protected LaTeX block, citation, number, comparison direction, and evidence scope.  Remove defensive writing, stacked hedging, repeated justification, preemptive clarification, imaginary objections, mechanical signposts, repetitive sentence patterns, list-form prose, and uniform paragraph scaffolding. Use coherent paragraphs and keep mean absolute IC attached to factor-expression candidates.
